pages.title: Base Stats
pages.text:
The doll with the highest stats in the mod. HP: 200.

• Regen VI + Resistance IV + Fire Resistance
• Full knockback resistance
• Immune to fire, lava, and all projectile damage (arrows, tridents, wither skulls, etc.)

Combat: Melee/Archer mode fires sonic booms (30 damage, armor-piercing, 1.5s charge, 4s cooldown). Looter: 3x XP + innate Looting III.

pages.title: How to Obtain
pages.text:
1. Use Echo Shard on Sculk Shrine to summon Wild Warden Doll
2. Defeat it — 60% chance to drop Warden Doll Head (+10% per Looting)
3. Craft the head with 8 Sculk blocks into Warden Doll Egg

Each shrine requires the previous boss to be dead before summoning again.
